O R D E R  1. Delay condoned.

2. Leave granted.
 3.
Heard learned Senior Counsel for the parties and carefully  perused the material placed on record.

4. We find that in the instant case, land was acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the public purpose of Strengthening  and widening of the East Coast Road (ECR) from Thiruvanmiyur to  Cuddalore by invoking the urgency clause.

sentences.text: Mr. P. Wilson, learned Senior Counsel for the   2 submits, and rightly so, that the subject land abutting the Highway is required for the purpose of widening of the Highway and to maintain the same width of the road, the respondents property is required.
In this regard, he has referred to the photographs taken at the site.
7. We have seen the photographs and perused the record.

We find that the claim of the respondent for payment of compensation under the 2013 Act, as on 01.01.2014, stands answered by this Court vide order dated 01.04.2025 passed in a batch of Civil Appeals with the lead case being C.A. No.4628 of 2025 @ SLP(C) No.15637/2023 (The State of Tamil Nadu & Ors. vs. N. Devanathan & Ors.).
8.
